get_landing_page_crawler_evidence.description: Get saved landing-page crawler evidence for an ad's submitted version. Includes metadata for successful and failed captures and, when available, a read-only screenshot URL valid for up to 24 hours. Returns 404 when no capture is available and 409 while the capture is pending. The status describes the crawl job, not the destination's HTTP status. This read-only operation does not start a crawl.
